objective: Correct PR #46 so the quality codebook preserves taxonomy dimensions and Code != Theme != Descriptor without collapsing acquisition techniques or failure boundaries into semantic interpretation.
instructions: BRANCH HANDOFF: remain on codex/ku2d-core-intelligence-v1. Fetch/pull the latest remote state and read queue.json from this branch before editing. Do not switch back to an older branch.
Read KU2D-V-000009 first and treat it as the controlling correction review for KU2D-R-000009 and Draft PR #46.

Keep PR #46 bounded to the Core Intelligence Quality Foundation. Do not implement the broader recommendation/ranking work from superseded KU2D-P-000008 and do not add sources, live acquisition, Survey/DoE/SEM, production behavior, ML execution/export, embeddings, vector storage, or runtime auto-writes.
Correct the current codebook model so codebook entries preserve their original core_knowledge_taxonomy dimension/family. Do NOT require every codebook entry to be code_kind=semantic_code.

Introduce a clear machine-readable distinction such as code_kind or code_family derived from the taxonomy dimension. At minimum preserve semantic_interpretation for SI-* codes, acquisition_technique for AT-* codes, and failure_boundary_type for FB-* codes. If other dimensions are codebooked later, the model must support them without pretending they are semantic interpretations.

Make codebook validation fail closed when a codebook entry claims a family/dimension inconsistent with its taxonomy ID. The validator should derive or cross-check the authoritative taxonomy dimension rather than trusting an arbitrary label.

Change the evidence-quality chain concept from Raw Evidence -> Prepared Evidence -> Descriptor -> Semantic Code -> Interpretation -> Decision to Raw Evidence -> Prepared Evidence -> Descriptor -> Code -> Interpretation -> Decision. Each Code record must carry its taxonomy dimension/family explicitly. Only codes from semantic_interpretation may be called semantic-interpretation codes.

Preserve Code != Theme != Descriptor. Add a minimal explicit Theme representation/layer or contract, preferably optional and downstream of coding, so a Theme is a broader analytical grouping and is not silently represented as an Interpretation. Theme must not masquerade as a code and must not confer Ground Truth or production authority.

Preserve Interpretation as a distinct contextual analytical statement referencing one or more codes/themes/evidence as appropriate. Do not redefine Theme as Interpretation merely to satisfy the distinction.

Update first-cycle/second-cycle coding validation so task-appropriate code families are allowed and retained. An acquisition-technique coding task may use AT-* codes; a failure-boundary task may use FB-* codes; a semantic-interpretation task may use SI-* codes. Add optional task/expected_dimension validation so reliability comparisons do not silently compare incompatible code families.

Update Independent Coding and Semantic Reliability contracts/helpers to preserve task and codebook version plus expected taxonomy dimension/code family where applicable. Fail closed or mark not_applicable for incompatible label families instead of calculating misleading agreement.

Add codebook coverage metadata that makes the adapter's current scope explicit: number of taxonomy IDs with full codebook guidance, dimensions covered, and IDs/dimensions not yet codebooked. Partial codebook coverage is acceptable; false completeness is not.

Keep include_when, exclude_when, positive_examples, counter_examples, commonly_confused_with, evidence_required, ontology openness, no_existing_code_fits, novel_pattern_candidate, raw-evidence immutability, Analytical Memo, Negative/Deviant Case, Finding Verification, and Quality Loop behavior intact.

Update documentation to explain that qualitative coding can include multiple code types/families; semantic interpretation is only one family. Explain Code vs Theme vs Descriptor vs Interpretation with one KU2D example for each.

Add deterministic regression tests at minimum for: SI code validates only as semantic_interpretation; AT code validates as acquisition_technique and fails if labelled semantic_interpretation; FB code validates as failure_boundary_type and fails if labelled semantic_interpretation; descriptor cannot be code; theme cannot be code; theme remains broader/non-authoritative; interpretation remains distinct from theme; coding task rejects wrong taxonomy dimension; reliability rejects/not_applicable incompatible dimensions; codebook coverage metadata is accurate; old reviewed fixtures still validate after deterministic migration/adapter; QF1-QF35 behavior remains preserved unless intentionally superseded by stronger corrected assertions.

Run git diff --check, JSON/YAML parsing, Python compilation, all Core Intelligence Quality tests, Core Knowledge tests, Learning Memory tests, Agent Handoff tests, complete deterministic Data Acquisition corpus, and relevant regressions. No live requests.
Update Draft PR #46 description with the corrected dimension-aware codebook model and exact current-head verification. Keep Draft and do not merge.

Write KU2D-R-000010 with exact branch/head, correction summary, taxonomy/codebook family model, Theme behavior, reliability dimension checks, coverage metadata, files changed, tests/CI/security/live-request count, production/ML boundaries, and blockers. Then hand control to assistant.
STOP after reporting. Do not proceed to broader Core Intelligence recommendation/ranking work.
